sentence: This project studies how a group of nerve cells in the spinal cord that hold back other cells affects movement after spinal cord injury.
This project studies how antibodies against the body's own proteins weaken the immune system during sepsis.
This project builds a three-dimensional model of an early primate embryo from chimpanzee stem cells to study how cells choose their fate.
This project tests whether a lack of a protein that helps handle zinc in lung progenitor cells contributes to lung aging.
This project studies how malaria in the placenta affects how the placenta works and builds simple tools to detect placental infection during pregnancy.
This project develops a method to correct for attenuation in imaging of cardiac sarcoidosis.
This project makes 3D printed scaffolds containing radiopaque tantalum oxide nanoparticles so clinicians can monitor healing of peripheral nerve injury.
This project tries to find out how stem cells make the right number of cells.
This project tries to find out how neurons combine stabilizing forms of plasticity to produce a behavior in a natural environment.
This project builds statistical methods that use whole-genome genealogies to study the genetics and evolution of complex traits.
This project tests whether injury in the human intestine turns a developmental gene program back on to repair and regenerate tissue.
This project studies how immune changes in mevalonate kinase deficiency, a rare inherited metabolic disorder, lead to inflammation.
This project studies how fearful reactivity and brain activity change over time and how maternal sensitivity affects the emergence of anxiety.
This project studies groups of genes that work together in bacteria and how they work across multiple species.
This project builds a microscopy platform that images proteins in three dimensions and tests it on mitochondrial shape in kidney, liver and brain tissues.
This project tests whether the intensity of smells and sounds is encoded on a common scale in the basolateral amygdala or orbitofrontal cortex.
This project builds a video and questionnaire dataset of people with tics and trains a computer algorithm to detect and measure tics automatically.
This project tests how irradiation used to inactivate airborne viruses affects the eyes and skin of mice.
